description:
Baseus USB Female To Type-C Male Adapter OTG Converter Black (CATOTG-01)
Convenient USB to USB Type C adapter produced by Baseus.
Made of high-quality, durable materials (aluminum alloy) converter with portable design.
Allows you to connect to your phone (with OTG function) many devices like pendrive, mouse, keyboard or gamepads.
Lightweight and easy to carry an accessory that provides stable data transfer and fast charging.
